about: What the suites are expected to give on a Mac (Apple silicon). 'checks' is the number of checks a suite makes; 'known' are checks that fail because of a finding not yet repaired; 'unsteady' are checks that depend on the state of the Mac and not on the build (see tests/README-TESTS.md). test15 is not run here (it needs qpdf). 'without' gives a suite's figures where the folder named in 'needs' is absent from the scratch folder of the run: the part that needs it is skipped, the suite counts as passed, and the run says so in one line.

without.say: 1 part skipped: it needs an earlier version that is not published
